result.summary: The food delivery app page appears visually clean and well-structured. No significant broken elements were detected beyond expected carousel and viewport clipping which are treated as normal.

issues.description: The favorite/heart icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card has a white background circle, while the heart icon on the pizza card below uses a dark/transparent background circle. This inconsistency in icon styling across similar cards looks unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart/favorite icon background treatment across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
